{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Final check: we are to compute the mean week-12 biomarker value across all patients in the trial
# 'week-12' corresponds to sample_seq == 2
# There are 48 patients with week-12 data (sample_seq == 2)
# Each such patient has exactly one week-12 measurement (since sample_seq is 1 or 2, and only one row per patient per sample_seq)
# Therefore, we can compute the mean directly over the 48 rows where sample_seq == 2

# Load data again for clarity
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for week-12 (sample_seq == 2)
week12_data = df[df['sample_seq'] == 2]

# Compute mean biomarker_final
mean_week12 = week12_data['biomarker_final'].mean()

# Output
print('Mean week-12 biomarker value:', mean_week12)"}
